name: goal-prompt-refiner
description: Turn durable project work into verified, project-grounded Codex Goals.

interface.shortDescription: Define verified Goals for durable project work
interface.longDescription: Uses interactive choices for material decisions while recovering the user's actual desired outcome, grounding it in project facts, and producing one verified Codex Goal with resumable project-local memory, checkpoints, validation, and explicit stopping conditions.
defaultPrompt: Refine my durable project objective and use interactive choices for material decisions.
Determine whether this request qualifies as a Codex Goal using interactive choices when needed.
Prepare a project-grounded /goal and use interactive choices for unresolved scope decisions.
